title: MouseVentures
description:
MouseVentures is a puzzle game where you control Pipo, a stuffed mouse. He will enter two storybooks to help the characters inside while use magnetism and light to solve the puzzles that stand in their way.

A little girl's handcrafted plush comes to life due to her imagination. He gets absorbed into storybooks where something isn't quite right and gets tasked with helping the little prince Arthur get his sword and an energetic bunny rescue his friend Quetzacóatl.

Explore a book based worldSolve incredible puzzlesMeet amazing characters!

This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
